leads.summary: Image-folder import counts image-named symlinks and subdirectories against its 128-file limit before it skips them

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** Set Image Folder rejects valid images within the documented limits.

### Import rejects 8-frame WebP and 48 MP photos

The policy sets `list-length` 8 and caps memory, map and disk; WebP decodes every frame before `-delete 1--1`, and an 8064x6048 JPEG exhausts the cache. **Impact:** one such file aborts the import; its notification names no file.

**Suggested change:** raise `list-length` (128 works), add `-define jpeg:size=`, and raise the caps or document a pixel limit.

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 1f20066)</summary>

```bash
#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail

source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/base-test.sh"
require_command magick

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmpdir/home" "$tmpdir/animated" "$tmpdir/photo"

# An animated WebP with eight frames; the converter keeps only the first.
frames=()
for (( n = 0; n < 8; n++ )); do
  magick -size 48x48 "xc:rgb($(( n * 30 )),128,128)" "$tmpdir/frame-$n.png"
  frames+=("$tmpdir/frame-$n.png")
done
magick -delay 10 "${frames[@]}" "$tmpdir/animated/animated.webp"

# A 48-megapixel JPEG (8064x6048, the full-resolution size of many phone
# cameras), well under the documented 20 MiB per-image limit.
magick -size 8064x6048 gradient:red-blue -quality 85 "$tmpdir/photo/photo.jpg"

status=0
for folder in animated photo; do
  if HOME="$tmpdir/home" OMARCHY_PATH="$ROOT" PATH="$ROOT/bin:$PATH" \
    "$ROOT/bin/omarchy-screensaver-import" "$tmpdir/$folder" >/dev/null 2>"$tmpdir/$folder.err"; then
    pass "a folder with one $folder image imports"
  else
    sed "s#$tmpdir#\$tmpdir#g" "$tmpdir/$folder.err" >&2
    printf 'not ok - %s\n' "a folder with one $folder image imports" >&2
    status=1
  fi
done
exit "$status"
```

Output at 1f200663 (ImageMagick 7.1.2-31 Q16-HDRI, exit status 1; temporary directory paths redacted to `$TMPDIR/omarchy-image-import-XXXXXX`):

```
magick: list length exceeds limit `$TMPDIR/omarchy-image-import-XXXXXX/input.webp' @ error/cache.c/OpenPixelCache/3815.
magick: no images found for operation `-auto-orient' at CLI arg 10 @ error/operation.c/CLIOption/5456.
Unable to convert image: $TMPDIR/omarchy-image-import-XXXXXX/input.webp
omarchy-screensaver-import: image conversion failed; selection unchanged
not ok - a folder with one animated image imports
magick: cache resources exhausted `$TMPDIR/omarchy-image-import-XXXXXX/input.jpg' @ error/cache.c/OpenPixelCache/4036.
Unable to convert image: $TMPDIR/omarchy-image-import-XXXXXX/input.jpg
omarchy-screensaver-import: image conversion failed; selection unchanged
not ok - a folder with one photo image imports
```

Output with `list-length` raised to 128 in the import policy and `-define jpeg:size="${pixel_width}x${pixel_height}"` added before the input in the colour branch of `omarchy-transcode-ascii` (exit status 0):

```
ok - a folder with one animated image imports
ok - a folder with one photo image imports
```
</details>

### Focus on no window no longer dismisses

`hyprctl activewindow -j` returns `{}` when nothing has focus; `screensaver_in_focus` now returns 0 for it; the merge-base exits. **Impact (source only):** on an empty workspace the windows stay mapped until a window takes focus, so the session can lock mid-use.

**Suggested change:** return 0 only on `hyprctl` failure; test the reply with `jq -e '.class == "org.omarchy.screensaver"'`.

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 1f20066)</summary>

```bash
#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail

source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/base-test.sh"
require_command jq

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
pid=""
cleanup() {
  [[ -n $pid ]] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -rf "$tmpdir"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

mkdir -p "$tmpdir/bin" "$tmpdir/home/.config/omarchy/branding"
printf 'ART\n' >"$tmpdir/home/.config/omarchy/branding/screensaver.txt"

# Hyprland answers `activewindow -j` with {} when no window has focus, for
# example after switching to an empty workspace.
cat >"$tmpdir/bin/hyprctl" <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
case "$1" in
  activewindow) echo '{}' ;;
  clients) echo '[]' ;;
esac
SH
printf '#!/bin/bash\nexec sleep 5\n' >"$tmpdir/bin/ttfx"
printf '#!/bin/bash\nexit 0\n' >"$tmpdir/bin/pgrep"
printf '#!/bin/bash\nexit 0\n' >"$tmpdir/bin/pkill"
printf '#!/bin/bash\necho /dev/pts/99\n' >"$tmpdir/bin/tty"
printf '#!/bin/bash\necho "60 160"\n' >"$tmpdir/bin/stty"
chmod +x "$tmpdir/bin/"*

# Keep stdin open and silent, so only the focus check can end the screensaver.
exec {silence}< <(sleep 10)
HOME="$tmpdir/home" OMARCHY_PATH="$ROOT" PATH="$tmpdir/bin:$ROOT/bin:$PATH" TMPDIR="$tmpdir" \
  "$ROOT/bin/omarchy-screensaver" <&"$silence" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
pid=$!

for (( attempt = 0; attempt < 40; attempt++ )); do
  kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
  sleep 0.1
done

if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
  fail "screensaver exits when focus moves to no window"
fi
pid=""
pass "screensaver exits when focus moves to no window"
```

Output at 1f200663 (exit status 1):

```
not ok - screensaver exits when focus moves to no window
```

Output at the merge-base 31bd80d (exit status 0):

```
ok - screensaver exits when focus moves to no window
```

Output at 1f200663 with `screensaver_in_focus` returning `jq -e '.class == "org.omarchy.screensaver"'` on the reply and keeping `|| return 0` only for a failed `hyprctl` call (exit status 0; the PR's own screensaver tests still pass with that change):

```
ok - screensaver exits when focus moves to no window
```
</details>

<details><summary>More findings</summary>

### Edit Text, Set From Image and Restore Default now depend on `shell.json`

These actions always call `select_source ""`, so each run rewrites `shell.json` with `jq -S` and requests a shell config reload, even with no collection selected. When `shell.json` cannot be parsed, or `.screensaver` is a string, number, array or boolean, they exit 1 after `screensaver.txt` is already replaced and before the preview; at the merge-base they succeed. **Impact:** a broken or hand-edited config that the shell itself tolerates now breaks these menu actions.

**Suggested change:** clear only when a selection exists, for example a wrapper that runs `jq -e '.screensaver.source? // empty' "$CONFIG_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0` before `select_source ""`, used in place of the three calls.

Reproducer (fails at 1f20066):

```bash
#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail

source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/base-test.sh"
require_command jq

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmpdir/bin" "$tmpdir/home/.config/omarchy/branding"
printf 'OLD\n' >"$tmpdir/home/.config/omarchy/branding/screensaver.txt"
printf '#!/bin/bash\necho "launch $*" >>"$CALLS"\n' >"$tmpdir/bin/omarchy-launch-screensaver"
printf '#!/bin/bash\necho "shell $*" >>"$CALLS"\n' >"$tmpdir/bin/omarchy-shell"
chmod +x "$tmpdir/bin/"*
config="$tmpdir/home/.config/omarchy/shell.json"

# The shell itself ignores a shell.json it cannot parse and uses its defaults.
printf '{ "version": 1, }\n' >"$config"
: >"$tmpdir/calls"
HOME="$tmpdir/home" OMARCHY_PATH="$ROOT" CALLS="$tmpdir/calls" PATH="$tmpdir/bin:$ROOT/bin:$PATH" \
  "$ROOT/bin/omarchy-branding-screensaver" reset 2>"$tmpdir/stderr" ||
  fail "restore default works when shell.json cannot be parsed" "$(<"$tmpdir/stderr")"
grep -qx 'launch force' "$tmpdir/calls" || fail "restore default previews the screensaver" "$(<"$tmpdir/calls")"
pass "restore default works when shell.json cannot be parsed"
```

Output at 1f200663 (exit status 1):

```
jq: parse error: Expected another key-value pair at line 1, column 17
omarchy-branding-screensaver: could not update shell config
not ok - restore default works when shell.json cannot be parsed
```

Output at the merge-base 31bd80d (exit status 0):

```
ok - restore default works when shell.json cannot be parsed
```

Output at 1f200663 with image, text and reset calling `select_source ""` only when `jq -e '.screensaver.source? // empty'` finds a selection (exit status 0; the PR's own branding test still passes):

```
ok - restore default works when shell.json cannot be parsed
```

### Import cap counts entries that are later skipped

`omarchy-screensaver-import` counts every visible image-named entry against the 128 cap before the `O_NOFOLLOW` open skips symlinks and non-regular files. A folder with one real PNG plus 128 PNG-named symlinks is refused; 128 PNG-named subfolders are refused the same way. **Impact:** a folder within the documented limit fails with a misleading image-count error, and the previous selection stays.

**Suggested change:** count only regular images after the no-follow check.

Reproducer (fails at 1f20066):

```bash
#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail

source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/base-test.sh"
require_command magick

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmpdir/home" "$tmpdir/images"

# One real image plus 128 image-named symlinks, which the import skips anyway.
magick -size 64x64 gradient:red-blue "$tmpdir/images/real.png"
for (( n = 0; n < 128; n++ )); do
  ln -s real.png "$tmpdir/images/link-$n.png"
done

if ! HOME="$tmpdir/home" OMARCHY_PATH="$ROOT" PATH="$ROOT/bin:$PATH" \
  "$ROOT/bin/omarchy-screensaver-import" "$tmpdir/images" >/dev/null 2>"$tmpdir/stderr"; then
  fail "skipped symlinks do not count against the 128-image cap" "$(<"$tmpdir/stderr")"
fi
pass "skipped symlinks do not count against the 128-image cap"
```

Output at 1f200663 (exit status 1):

```
omarchy-screensaver-import: choose a folder with 1–128 PNG, JPEG or WebP images
not ok - skipped symlinks do not count against the 128-image cap
```

</details>

<details><summary>Details</summary>

**Verified:**
- Text folders play in filename order, advance after each effect and wrap; missing, empty or invalid sources fall back to `screensaver.txt`, then the bundled logo.
- The SGR grammar in `omarchy-screensaver-prepare` accepts only forms ttfx parses; OSC, C1, cursor controls and other control characters are rejected.
- PNG, JPEG and WebP import in colour, braille and block modes with numeric order preserved; a failed import leaves no partial directory.
- `shell.json` writes keep the symlink and file mode; dismissal kills only the owned effect and closes validated window addresses.
- Both new test files pass at the head and with the PR applied to current `quattro`, together with base's `screensaver-workspace-test.sh`.

**Optional notes:**
- **Optional test improvement:** `screensaver-branding-test.sh` stubs the converter without checking its arguments, so changing the import default from `color` to `braille` still passes. Asserting the stub's `--mode` argument would catch that.
- **Docs:** the manual's `omarchy-screensaver-import ~/Pictures/giants --mode braille` only creates an import folder and does not select it. `manual/13-toggles-idle-screensaver.md`, the top of `manual/41-branding.md`, the converter paragraph there (braille or block) and `omarchy-transcode-ascii`'s usage still list PNG/SVG input or omit `color`.
- **Related open PRs:** #13083 adds a `paint)` arm to `omarchy-branding-screensaver` that saves `screensaver.txt`, which a selected collection would hide; the two also touch the same metadata lines. #11732 adds `idle.screensaverEffect` while this PR adds top-level `screensaver.source`. #11732 and #13631 edit the same ttfx call; #13647 and #12258 edit the focus check.
</details>
